column2: Measure whether AI search reaches high-intent buyers and contributes to qualified pipeline, not merely visibility.
Are improvements in AI answer presence and accuracy followed by measurable buyer actions: AI referrals, branded demand, qualified opportunities and pipeline?
16 weeks; 5 buyer prompts × 4 assistants = 20 weekly answers; GA4-style acquisition; GSC branded search; CRM opportunities; optional paid AI media.
Brand Presence Rate; Linked Citation Rate; Answer Accuracy; AI Referral CVR; Branded Search Growth; AI Self-Reported Opportunities; Qualified Pipeline.
Improving presence and accuracy on high-intent AI prompts should lead, with a lag, to more AI referral conversions, branded search and qualified opportunities.
Baseline → intervention marker → weekly trend → lag analysis → funnel/attribution → recommendations.
All data in this workbook is synthetic and created for portfolio/testing purposes.
